scope.source_reading: Complete original implementation and all final changed sections; overlapping reads cover final lines 1 through 882.
scope.full_suite: Not run by this reviewer; integration owner records separately.

independent_arithmetic.oracle: Hand-calculated Decimal constants, without calling engine economics helpers.
independent_arithmetic.budget_boundary: Ask 0.977 exactly fits the 100.00 cap including both fees; ask 0.977001 rounds conservatively to 100.01 including both fees and is refused.

tested_failures_and_invariants: Independent books and non-resetting initialization; rejection of nested overlapping books
Exact cash, fees, exit reserves, partial sales, whole units and immutable registration
No naked sale, oversell, unfunded entry or reuse of restricted sale proceeds
Invalid contract multipliers, deliverables, strike, cutoff, nonfinite cash and quantities
Quote identity, source, payload attribution, timestamp ordering, capture delay, age and quality
Latest invalid quote invalidates prior good fill and valuation; later qualified quote recovers
Existing payload hash cannot be retimestamped under a new quote ID
Post-commit readiness interruption preserves reservation; identical retry recovers; pre-readiness quotes stay unfillable
Identical retries, conflicting retries, cancellation and no duplicate quote fill
Two concurrent cash reservations cannot overcommit; two identical concurrent fills debit once
Artificial failure after SQL insertion before commit rolls back the entire fill
Payload/hash/interior omission/duplicate-key corruption refuses read and write without repair
A deliberately rehashed wrong-cash fill fails deterministic accounting replay
Missing database remains missing; wrong host or modified engine cannot mutate existing book
Stale/unqualified marks yield unknown NAV while preserving cash and positions
Expiry and exact cutoff prevent fills; nearly worthless options are not silently zero-settled
findings_resolved_during_review: Retain attributable invalid latest quote and invalidate earlier good observations
Add post-commit intent readiness and interrupted-readiness recovery
Use local_input_simulation evidence label and deterministic replay wording
limitations: All tests use artificial inputs and a private clock seam; no live prices, broker order or investment performance were established.
This reviewer did not run a full project suite or review the separate CLI implementation; those have separate owners and evidence.
External payload and contract hashes are operator attribution, not authenticated feed or deliverable verification.
The hash chain cannot detect valid tail truncation or a complete privileged rewrite without an independently retained checkpoint.
One pending instruction per book; quoted display size is not queue-priority or market-impact evidence.
Sale proceeds remain permanently restricted; settlement, dividends, corporate actions, calendar, lifecycle resolution and a tradable strategy remain activation blockers.
Long whole-share stocks and long standard options only; no short leg, spread, assignment or exercise handling.
Zero or negative net liquidation proceeds are refused and left unknown; funded fee-only disposal is not implemented.
Failed fill requests raise without an appended refusal event; callers must retain errors and must not claim persisted refusals.
Host/path/source checks protect this local book API, not a distributed lease or protection against an administrator copying and changing state.
